target_customer: B2B companies with marketing sites that want visitors to see tailored content
problem: Marketing sites speak to everyone at once, so most traffic does not convert; the founders claim 98 percent of web traffic does not convert.
business_model: B2B SaaS with a free plan and paid tiers

founders.name: Christopher Mjelde
education: King's College London, BSc business management
previous_startups: Verdn (environmental pledging and donation software, built over 4+ years)

founders.name: Rory McMeekin
founders.background_notes: Full stack web developer and designer per YC page.

competitors.name: RB2B
competitors.what: Website visitor deanonymization tool named in the Kenobi launch post

competitors.name: Vector
competitors.what: Visitor deanonymization tool named in the launch post

competitors.name: Intellimize
competitors.what: AI website personalization and optimization for marketers
competitors.traction_then: Reported 1,338 percent revenue growth over two years in 2019 coverage

competitors.name: Mutiny
competitors.what: AI personalization of website copy and headlines for B2B sites
competitors.traction_then: Customers included Dropbox, Snowflake, Qualtrics and Carta
competitors.funding_then: 50M USD Series B in 2022, co-led by Tiger Global and Insight Partners

technical_complexity.rationale: A script tag plus LLM generated content and enrichment; the product is mostly integration and prompt design.

defensibility.rationale: Feature is easy to copy and better funded rivals Intellimize and Mutiny already sold personalization.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded rivals continued to grow; no sourced incumbent acquisition of Kenobi.

market_need_then: Launch post claims opted in visitors engage 3x longer and convert 2x better (company figures); B2B marketers were funding personalization tools in 2021 and 2022.

identity.voice_and_tone: Concierge metaphor: the product acts as a front desk concierge for each visitor (YC description).

branding.brand_signature: A cue card widget asking visitors which company they are from

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable pop culture style name but no source confirms the Star Wars link, and searches return only the character.

pivots.to: Kenobi, customized landing pages for outbound sales
pivots.why: Launch post says they pivoted in May after 4+ years on Verdn; year not stated

pivots.from: Customized landing pages for outbound campaigns
pivots.to: Visitor facing personalization for inbound traffic
pivots.why: Customers asked for it for inbound web traffic

outcome_analysis: Kenobi pivoted from Verdn into website personalization and joined YC in Winter 2022 as a three person London team. A single aggregator reports a seed round in March 2022 and about 1 million dollars raised in total, while larger rivals Intellimize and Mutiny raised tens of millions. It is still listed active with no exit; the company site now describes a different design systems product, so its outcome is unclear.
notes: Caplight (aggregator only) lists a seed on 2022-03-29, about 1M USD total, with Gaingels, Climate Capital, Fin Venture Capital, Y Combinator and Correlation; unverified so no round recorded. The kenobi.ai homepage is titled Design Systems from Any URL, suggesting a later product change; undated and not recorded as a pivot. Launch post date taken as batch time (Winter 2022) since the YC page gives no date. Mutiny round date conflicts between April and May 2022. Rory McMeekin's link to Verdn comes from a search result and the launch post saying 'the founders'. No outcome events found.
